description: The full agent-ready 'know this wallet' report in ONE call: native + ERC-20 balances (USD-priced), a rolled-up total + top holdings, AND the active token approvals (revoke risk) across many of the 23 EVM chains — including young chains big indexers skip. The approvals half is heavy: needs NODEFLARE_API_KEY or X402_PRIVATE_KEY (balances/USD come back either way).

chains.description: Chains to include — slug/name/ID; defaults to all 23
